**Principal Consultant - AI & Data Advisory

**The Role:

**NNIT is strengthening its Advisory & AI capability to help life sciences clients turn AI and data ambition into

measurable business outcomes. We are looking for an experienced management consultant with strong

commercial capabilities who can originate opportunities, advise senior executives, shape compelling

transformation agendas, and convert them into high-value client engagements. Technology understanding is

required, but the primary mandate is management consulting, commercial growth and trusted executive

advisory.

The role sits in AI & Data Advisory under Advisory & AI and works across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain

and cross-functional regulated capabilities. It is a client- and market-facing management consulting role that

opens and support senior conversations, frames business value and creates demand. The role then connects

qualified opportunities to NNIT domain and technology specialists, including our AI Factory in the Philippines,

without being expected to act as the lead technologist or solution architect. However, the person should be able

to drive projects as engagement manager as well.

**Your responsibilities as Principal Consultant - AI & Data Advisory:

Deliver and manage senior AI & Data advisory engagements: Deliver senior management consulting

engagements covering AI strategy and governance, AI readiness, data and analytics strategy, AI-enabled

quality and continuous improvement, transformation programs, and AI-enabled operating models. Frame the

business choices, organizational implications, investment priorities and value case.

Deliver and develop AI & Data Advisory offerings: Position, sell and deliver NNIT’s portfolio of AI and data

management consulting offerings. The AI Value Compass is one example. Use client engagements, market

insight and commercial experience to provide structured input to the development, refinement and scaling of

additional offerings. Facilitate executive discovery and decision-making, assess opportunities and readiness,

prioritize value pools and translate outcomes into board-ready narratives, business cases, roadmaps and clear

next steps.

Convert advisory into implementation and measurable value: Use advisory engagements and the broader

offering portfolio to create credible follow-on opportunities across transformation, implementation, validation and

managed services. Maintain senior client sponsorship and commercial continuity while appropriately handing

technical design and execution to the relevant specialists.

Bridge clients, domains and the AI Factory: Act as the commercial and consulting bridge between client

executives, NNIT business areas and AI delivery capacity in the Philippines. Translate business priorities into a

clear engagement scope and value case, bring in architects and technical specialists at the right time, and retain

accountability for the client relationship, commercial outcome and realized value.

Shape AI and data solutions across Life Sciences: Work across Clinical, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply

Chain, Quality and other regulated areas to identify strategically important client problems and shape crosscapability responses. Use sufficient AI and data understanding to challenge, qualify and explain solutions, while

drawing on NNIT specialists for technical depth.

Drive commercial growth with Sales and other Business Areas: Carry a clear commercial mandate to

originate and qualify opportunities, build executive relationships, shape client demand, lead proposals and RfPs,

develop Statements of Work and commercial cases, and convert advisory entry points into larger multi-service

relationships. Contribute directly to pipeline, bookings, revenue and account growth.

Strengthen repeatable offerings and assets: Actively contribute to the development and commercialisation of

new AI and data advisory offerings. Bring recurring client needs, market insight and delivery experience into

offering design; help test propositions with clients; and refine methods, executive workshop formats, commercial

narratives, pricing logic and reusable assets in partnership with domain and technology specialists.

Represent NNIT in the market: Build executive credibility through client events, industry forums, thought

leadership and strategic partnerships, positioning NNIT around business outcomes, regulated execution and

responsible AI.

Line-manage and develop consultants: Act as line manager for a small team of consultants, with

responsibility for regular one-to-ones, performance and development conversations, staffing input, coaching and

creating clear expectations. Support consultants in executive advisory, problem structuring, value-case

development, commercial shaping and account development.

**What You Will Work On

**Typical management consulting engagements may include:

• AI strategy, governance and readiness assessments for regulated life sciences organizations

• AI and data strategy, discovery, and value-assessment engagements, including e.g. the AI Value Compass as one available offering, followed where relevant by transformation or value-realization programs

• Data and analytics strategy, data readiness and trusted data foundations for AI

• AI-enabled Quality, risk, knowledge and continuous-improvement initiatives

• Agentic workflows and AI-enabled operating model design, with appropriate human oversight and governance

• Client-specific AI and data solutions delivered with NNIT domain specialists and the AI Factory

**Your Qualifications And Experience:

• 10+ years of management consulting experience, preferably from a recognized strategy, management or technology consulting firm, with a strong record in life sciences or other regulated industries. Senior

• Principal candidates should demonstrate broader C-level relationships, substantial commercial ownership and account growth, together with experience managing and developing consultants.

• Proven management consulting toolkit: hypothesis-led problem solving, executive interviewing and facilitation, operating model and transformation design, quantitative value-case development, and concise board-level storytelling.

• Sufficient understanding of AI strategy, responsible AI and governance, data strategy, analytics, GenAI and agentic approaches to advise executives, challenge assumptions and work credibly with specialists. Deep hands-on engineering or architecture expertise is not required.

• Life sciences experience strongly preferred, including an understanding of regulated environments and the implications of GxP, quality, validation and data governance for AI-enabled solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, build executive alignment, develop business cases and transformation roadmaps, and maintain senior sponsorship as work moves into implementation and value tracking.

• Strong commercial track record in originating consulting opportunities, opening new executive relationships, expanding strategic accounts, leading proposals/RfPs, negotiating scope and commercials, and shaping Statements of Work.

• Ability to mobilize and coordinate multidisciplinary teams across management consulting, life sciences domains, architecture, data/AI and distributed delivery, without needing to be the deepest technical expert.

• Experience as a people or line manager, including performance management, development planning, coaching and supporting staffing decisions.

• Strong facilitation, storytelling and executive presentation skills. Fluency in English is required. Danish and/or German language skills would be a distinct advantage.

**What Success Looks Like:

• Clients see you as a trusted management consultant who can frame complex choices, create executive alignment and connect AI and data investments to measurable business outcomes.

• AI and data advisory engagements, including the AI Value Compass where relevant, convert into credible roadmaps and, where appropriate, implementation and longer-term value partnerships.

• The AI Factory is connected to commercially qualified, well-shaped client demand, with clear ownership between advisory, technology specialists and delivery.

• AI and data work pulls through NNIT domain, platform, validation and managed-service capabilities without creating a separate silo

• Client work creates reusable assets and referenceable outcomes that strengthen NNIT’s market position and future pipeline.

**Why Join Advisory & AI:

This role is positioned at the front of NNIT’s client agenda: opening strategic conversations, building trusted

executive relationships, framing value and converting demand into material consulting and transformation

engagements. You will work across NNIT’s life sciences domains, deliver existing offerings and provide marketled input to develop the next generation of AI and data advisory propositions, supported by NNIT’s domain and

technology specialists.

**About NNIT:

NNIT provides consulting and IT services to life sciences and other regulated organizations. Our direction is to

combine deep domain expertise, advisory, technology and global delivery to create tangible customer impact. In

this role, that means bringing AI and data into real regulated business contexts and ensuring that ideas move

from executive ambition to scalable execution.

**About NNIT

NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

**Role

**The Senior Manager, Inspection Readiness - Good Clinical Practice, plays a key role in supporting the Clinical Trial Operations organization by embedding clinical compliance and inspection readiness into clinical trials and service provider oversight. This position is essential for maintaining a high level of clinical trial inspection readiness while ensuring adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. The individual will also lead process improvement initiatives.

This is an individual contributor role at the Senior Manager level, reporting to the Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead.

**Responsibilities

****Trial Inspection Readiness and Preparation

**

• Design and optimize tools and processes for trial inspection readiness, leveraging digitalization and automation to improve efficiency and compliance.

• Guide study teams in maintaining trial inspection readiness by providing GCP and clinical compliance support, including risk identification, mitigation and monitoring; management of serious GCP breaches and other reportable or non-reportable persistent non-compliance events; and follow-up and closure of quality events, thereby strengthening sponsor oversight.

• Conduct ongoing assessments of compound and/or trial inspection readiness by analyzing key metrics to generate actionable insights.

• Lead the development and delivery of GCP inspection readiness training and tools for Clinical Trial Operations and other key stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with GCP QA to support the operational framework and inspection setup during sponsor, site and vendor GCP inspections.

• Facilitate lessons-learned activities based on inspection readiness assessments, preparations and outcomes within Clinical Trial Operations.

**Quality Events Oversight

**

• Maintain oversight of Clinical Trial Delivery quality events and effectiveness checks, ensuring compliance with applicable requirements.

• Analyze trends in findings from audits, inspections and quality events, as relevant to Clinical Trial Operations and other key stakeholders.

**Clinical Compliance

**

• Provide guidance and support on ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA and NMPA) and Genmab SOPs.

• Lead and contribute to functional and/or cross-functional business process improvements, system enhancements and innovative initiatives.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s (BSc) or master’s degree (MSc) in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine or a related discipline.

• A minimum of 8 years of experience in Clinical Operations, Clinical Quality, Inspection Readiness or Clinical Compliance within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and the clinical drug development lifecycle.

• Strong project management skills and knowledge of relevant tools and processes.

• Experience mentoring colleagues and supporting their professional development.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to proactively identify risks, develop mitigation strategies and effectively resolve issues.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions in a complex, global, matrix organization.

$130,720.00---$196,080.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Senior Manager, Strategy & Transformation

Are you motivated by helping organizations with business transformations – often driven by AI, data and digital technology? And would you like to combine advisory work with client relationships and business development of Valcon?

As a Senior Manager in our Strategy & Transformation team, you will work closely with clients to solve complex business challenges and help turn strategic ambitions into sustainable results. You will take a leading role in client engagements while contributing to the continued development and growth of our Strategy & Transformation offerings.

Role and profile

You will work particularly within strategic business transformation, operating models and leading people through change to help our clients navigate complex projects in an environment increasingly shaped by AI, data and digital technology. You will build strong relationships with clients, understand their challenges and translate these into impactful transformation initiatives. Depending on the engagement, you may lead larger projects and work alongside other colleagues in multidisciplinary Valcon teams.

You bring solid experience from management consulting and are comfortable moving between strategic thinking and practical execution. Relevant work experience of minimum 8 years is expected. Experience with AI, Data or Technology driven Business Transformation is a clear advantage.

To thrive in the role, you will contribute across three equally areas:

• Client delivery and engagement: Lead and deliver complex transformations and critical projects fronting office-floor employees and executives, from mobilisation through implementation, creating strong collaboration and high-quality business impact.

• Commercial growth: Build trusted client relationships, understand client needs and identify opportunities where Valcon can create added value.

• Service development: Further develop our Strategy & Transformation capabilities, methodologies and approaches, with AI, data and technology as an important driver.

You will have a high degree of autonomy while being part of a collaborative team where we develop solutions, client relationships and capabilities together.

What you bring

• Strategy & transformation experience: You have strong experience within strategic transformations, change leadership and operating models and able to move from ambition to execution to value.

• Consulting skills: You are comfortable taking responsibility, navigating and solving complex problems, and collaborating closely with clients and colleagues to find the right way forward in high paced environments.

• People skills: You enjoy working with people and know how to build trust, communicate and engage stakeholders and create direction in teams and client relationships.

• Business acumen: You think business impact while keeping a pragmatic focus on what works in practice.

• Tech Savvy and Curiosity: You are curious about how AI, data and digital technology are changing businesses and is continuously developing yourself in this space.

• Education and language: You have relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience and communicate fluently and professionally in English. Danish is an advantage.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Aarhus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within Denmark and the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

Would you like to lead the Accounting Data & Monitoring team in Reporting Solutions responsible for several business-critical data hubs of accounting and financial data used in business solutions and reporting processes? Do you want to build a team in Reporting Solutions for a specific business purpose? Do you want a leading role in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Development Manager to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will head the Accounting Data & Monitoring team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable accounting and financial data across business solutions and reporting processes. Part of the business solutions are managed in a partnership with Accenture.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with Mainframe, Netezza, SAS, Kafka, and Databricks platforms and does coding in Cobol, Java, Python, and SQL and apply BI tools such as PowerCenter an SAP Business Objects. The team is currently situated in Herning, Roskilde, and Warsaw but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

Your direct manager will be Development Director, Mikkel Kallerup Olsen.

**Your primary task and responsibilities include:

**

• Manage a team of 10-15 highly dedicated Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects.

• Maintain ownership of all systems, platforms, and data within the business area of Finance. Solutions, ensuring operational stability and scalability.

• Manage incidents and problems effectively while ensuring alignment with architectural principles and guidelines.

• Oversee lifecycle management, compliance, audits, patches, and technical vulnerabilities.

• Ensure delivery of the team backlog, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day operations.

• Collaborate with vendors, architecture teams, and other domains to ensure transparency on progress, decisions, and dependencies.

• Drive continuous improvement of work processes, collaboration, and technical solutions.

• Align recruitment and skill development activities to the domain’s road map and long-term needs.

• Build a high-performing team, fostering professional growth through mentoring and training.

• Promote a culture of cross-functional collaboration and shared accountability.

To succeed you will have:

• A relevant Master degree.

• 5y+ work experience as Manager from Banking or financial IT.

• Knowledge of accounting, financial, and regulatory data.

• Preferably, work experience from the banking sector in Denmark.

• Preferably, work experience as Project Manager.

• Preferably, experience in managing external vendors.

• Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.

• Excellent people management skills, especially recruitment skills.

• Proven track record in change management of technology.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

As a person, you are ambitious, goal oriented, and persistent. You have a curious and analytical mindset. You are a team player who is proactive and takes responsibility. You are service minded towards both clients and colleagues.

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Attraction Partner Anders Skak-Arnstrup at rud@bec.dk.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. At Siteimprove, we are the leader in agentic content intelligence. Siteimprove.ai is a unified platform that brings together accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy into a single, continuous flow. Our AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams — not instead of them — helping to create high-performing, accessible content that's easy to discover by both humans and AI.

As Senior Engineering Manager for Content Platform, you own the systems that acquire and ingest the content our entire product line reasons about. Our enterprise customers bring thousands of sites each, re-crawled continuously. Every accessibility finding, analytics number, and SEO recommendation begins as content one of your systems fetched, parsed, and stored.

You will lead two Copenhagen engineering teams, each with its own Technical Leader role held by a Principal Engineer. The two carry different hard problems. One sustains crawl throughput so that cost tracks value rather than volume. The other builds the shared foundations the rest of Siteimprove works through, so product lines reach content through common contracts rather than each solving it their own way. You represent this group's engineering in a trio with Product and UX. Pillar strategy is set with Seattle, nine hours behind you, and you are the leader on the ground who turns it into local decisions rather than waiting on it.

Your teams set the ceiling on what the rest of Siteimprove can build. Your goals follow from that — ingestion reliable enough that customers trust it, efficient enough that cost tracks value rather than volume, capable enough to feed our agentic products, and ready for the compliance bar our public sector customers require. You will use AI to build the platform that powers our AI products and stay close enough to the code to argue a design on its merits.

What we will be doing

• Decision Authority in Copenhagen: You are the decision-maker on the ground. Resolve in Copenhagen hours what would otherwise wait overnight. As engineering's voice in the group's trio, bring the constraints Product and UX have no way to see into scope conversations early enough to change them. Your director sets goals with you and discusses how you and the group are tracking against them.

• Platform Ownership: Own Content Platform's ingestion surface as a running business — availability, throughput, cost, and delivery predictability. Modernization is how you improve those numbers, not a separate program you report on. Our move to EKS is part of it. You decide which debt gets paid down and when and keep that trade-off in front of the trio.

• Architectural Direction: Own the constraints and the cross-team contracts your Technical Leaders design within: scheduling the crawl workload so cost tracks value rather than volume, moving ingestion onto event-driven services, and defining how the rest of Siteimprove consumes what we ingest. You will hold that direction with your senior engineers, because authority here is earned in design review.

• Delivery Under Pressure: Hold the delivery line when priorities move. Work arrives from outside the team continuously, and you will sequence so committed work reaches completion rather than stalling half-built. Align directly with peer engineering leaders and close the gaps at functions you depend on but don't manage.

• Measurable Impact: Define the KPIs these systems are judged by and hold your teams to them. You will prove the impact of what you prioritize in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than asserting it, and you will stop work that moves none of them.

• Growing Your Engineers: Own performance, career development, and compensation decisions for the group. Hand the Tech Vision and System Design for major initiatives to the engineers closest to the systems, and review rather than drive them.

• AI-Native Delivery: Use AI for engineering throughput, not just for product features. You will model the practice yourself: interpreting legacy code paths nobody documented, generating test coverage around behavior before you change it, and shortening the distance between a design decision and a working replacement

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Ownership at Distance: A group whose outcomes you owned while the people setting direction sat elsewhere. We want evidence of decisions you made rather than escalated, because waiting would have cost more than being wrong. This role also asks for a standing weekly overlap in your late afternoon, when the Seattle day begins, so that the conversation with your director is a working one.

• Systems Depth: 7+ years in backend engineering, with real depth in distributed systems, high-throughput data ingestion, or crawling at scale. Comfort establishing how an undocumented system behaves before changing it, and the instinct to reach for AI to do that quickly.

• Leadership Through Leaders: 10+ years managing engineers, including senior technical leaders whose designs you reviewed rather than produced, and whose scope you expanded rather than absorbed.

• Architectural Judgment: A track record of moving established services onto cloud-native infrastructure and of designing interfaces other teams build on. What matters is having lived with both long enough to know which decisions held and which leaked.

Work Environment

• This is a hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, with the opportunity to work from both the office and home. Our working language is English.

• Travel may be required up to 5% of the time.

• You will work across a nine-hour spread with product and engineering leadership in Seattle, and with peer teams in other Siteimprove locations. Your late afternoon overlaps the start of the Seattle day, and the role expects you to keep a weekly window there for goal-setting and progress discussions with leadership.

What we will love about you

These systems quietly carry the entire product. If you're ready to make them faster and cheaper to run without stopping the business that depends on them, we'd love to hear from you. Join us in helping enterprise marketing teams turn their vast content into clear, actionable insights that drive measurable business results.

What you'll love about us

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.

Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.

Prepare for the future: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals.

RESOLVA is assisting INVISIO with the recruitment of a Corporate Legal Counsel.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

INVISIO is looking for a commercially minded and pragmatic Corporate Legal Counsel to support its global business. This is a broad legal generalist role with a strong commercial focus, where you will work closely with the business and provide legal support across a wide range of matters, with particular emphasis on international contracts, tenders, customer projects and other commercial legal matters.

As Corporate Legal Counsel, you will become part of a small legal team together with Signe Karstoft, Legal Director, to whom you will report. The role is based at INVISIO’s headquarters in Hvidovre, and the legal function is organisationally anchored within INVISIO’s Sales & Program function, which consists of approximately 50 employees globally, including around 25-30 in Denmark. You will primarily support the global sales organisation and work closely with colleagues across the business. Much of your work will involve large and complex customer contracts, tenders and projects.

You will provide legal support across INVISIO’s international business, including in relation to US contracts, such as contracts within the defence sector, and support sales teams across Europe and other markets. You will also support INVISIO in connection with major public tenders, including tenders involving ministries and defence organisations, providing legal support on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

As a technology company, intellectual property is an important part of INVISIO’s business. While dedicated specialists handle areas such as patents, you may also advise on IP-related matters as part of the broader commercial legal support. Experience with IP or from a technology or other IP-intensive business would therefore be an advantage.

In addition to the day-to-day legal support, you will contribute to developing and improving the way Legal supports the business. This includes driving legal improvement initiatives, maintaining and developing contract templates and legal guidelines, and conducting workshops and awareness activities for the business.

The role is highly international and outward-facing, with significant interaction with customers and stakeholders at all levels. You will have opportunities to join customer visits and negotiate contracts abroad, as well as participate in trade fairs in Denmark, Europe and the US.

The role is expected to involve approximately 25 travel days per year.

As INVISIO continues to grow rapidly, you will work in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and no two days are the same.

AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

INVISIO is looking for an independent and commercially minded lawyer who takes ownership and enjoys working closely with customers and colleagues across the organisation. Your key responsibilities will include:

Commercial contracts and negotiations:

• 
Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including large international sales contracts, non-disclosure agreements, letters of intent, consulting agreements, tender-related contracts and distribution agreements.

• 
Take an active role in customer dialogue and contract negotiations and provide commercially focused legal advice, working closely with relevant stakeholders to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives.

• 
Provide pragmatic legal advice on contractual and other commercial matters arising in the day-to-day business.

Tenders and customer projects:

• 
Provide legal support in connection with major public tenders, including reviewing tender documentation and advising on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

• 
Advise on legal and contractual aspects of tender structures, including which INVISIO entity should participate and any related intercompany arrangements.

• 
Support and, where relevant, take a coordinating role in customer projects and other commercial initiatives, including advising on contractual set-ups, priorities and how existing solutions can be applied in different markets etc.

IP and export control:

• Ad hoc Advise on IP and export control matters, including IP considerations in commercial agreements and questions relating to export restrictions and requirements in connection with international sales and customer projects.

Legal development and business support:

• 
Develop, maintain and improve contract templates, legal guidelines and other tools.

• 
Drive legal improvement initiatives and conduct workshops and legal awareness activities for the business, for example in relation to NDA’s.

• 
Provide ad hoc legal advice and support across INVISIO as required.

REPORTING AND TITLE

Reporting to: Signe Karstoft, Legal Director.

Title: Corporate Legal Counsel.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE

Education: You hold a master’s degree in law (cand.jur. or cand.merc.jur).

Work experience: You have approximately 3-6 years of relevant legal experience from an in-house role, for example in a technology or software company or another larger international industrial company.

Legal areas of specialisation: You have strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements and are comfortable handling contractual matters independently. You also have experience supporting tender processes and advising on the legal and contractual matters that arise in this context.

In addition, you have a broad legal profile and are able to navigate a varied range of legal matters. Experience with IP-related matters, particularly from a technology or other IP-intensive business, would be an advantage. Knowledge of export control would also be beneficial.

Commercial: You have a strong commercial mindset and understand how legal advice fits into the broader business context.

You have experience working directly with customers and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues at all levels of the organisation. You are able to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives and provide pragmatic, solution-oriented advice.

Language skills: You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and verbal.

PERSONAL CAPABILITIES

Independent & proactive: You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities and proactively drive matters forward.

Outgoing & interpersonal: You are outgoing and enjoy interacting with people with different backgrounds and at all levels, both internally and externally. You have strong interpersonal skills and are comfortable engaging with customers, colleagues and senior management.

Analytical & pragmatic: You have strong analytical skills and are able to understand complex legal and commercial matters while maintaining a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.

Structured & able to prioritise: You work in a structured manner, maintain a good overview of your responsibilities and are able to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment where new and urgent matters frequently arise. You remain calm and focused when priorities change or deadlines are tight.

Stakeholder management & collaboration: You build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and organisational levels. You are a team-oriented colleague who contributes to a strong sense of teamwork across the organisation and is able to influence stakeholders in a constructive manner.

Positive & constructive: You have a professional approach to your work and interact with others with maturity and integrity. You bring positive energy, are resilient when challenges arise and remain constructive in a busy environment.

INVISIO’S VALUE PROPOSITION TO YOU

INVISIO is a rapidly growing company with ambitious growth targets. The company achieves these ambitions through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts will be important to INVISIO’s continued success, and by joining the company, you will become part of an international headquarter with an informal working environment.

INVISIO offers a wide range of professional and social employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

INVISIO is a global leader in communications technology for professionals working in mission-critical environments. Established in Denmark in 1999, the company develops and markets advanced, integrated communication systems for defence and public safety professionals, helping users communicate clearly and safely in demanding environments.

INVISIO’s modular and scalable portfolio includes headsets, control units, intercom systems, hubs and software designed to work together across dismounted, vehicle-based and command operations. The solutions are marketed under the INVISIO and Racal Acoustics brands.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. **

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**

• Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

• Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

• Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

• Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm

• IaC: Terraform, Terragrunt

• CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub/Gitlab, ArgoCD

• Observability: DataDog

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

Job description

We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• Design and implement planning excellence: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• Enable adoption and capability building: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• Translate requirements into actionable processes: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• Guide digital planning transformations: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• You’re excited to live a year in Copenhagen to immerse yourself in our strong Implement culture while working in an international team and to build a broad network at Implement.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note that for the first year, you’ll be employed in our Copenhagen office, Implement’s HQ, before joining the Aarhus office.

What you’ll bring

As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• Relevant experience: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• Project-driven and adaptable: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• Interest in digital tools: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• Analytical problem-solver: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• Structured communicator: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is considered a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

What we offer

At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• Build deep functional expertise: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• Continuous development: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• An exciting start to your career: Feel the energy and atmosphere at our Copenhagen HQ for one year, joining a cohort of international graduates. Build a community and engage in a steep learning programme into the world of supply chain planning before you move on to the Aarhus office.

Make your next move matter.

How to apply

Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027 in Copenhagen.

About Implement

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

**Looking for a place where you can set direction, not just make recommendations?

**We are looking for a Strategist & Client Lead to join our Strategy Team. You will lead a portfolio of some of our most strategic client relationships and be the senior partner they turn to when they shape their customer, data and marketing agenda.

As a European consultancy and a leading Adobe specialist partner, we help ambitious organizations get real business value from their Adobe CX Enterprise / Adobe Experience Platform investments. We do it by combining strategy, data and technology into clear approaches that are built around outcomes.

In this role, you help clients define where they want to go and why. Then you turn that ambition into clear roadmaps, priorities and decisions. Strategy only matters when it changes how a business performs, so your job is to make sure every recommendation leads to measurable impact. That’s why you own both the strategic direction and the commercial success of your portfolio, because we believe that lasting growth comes from staying truly relevant to our clients.

****Your Responsibilities

********Strategic direction and advisory

• Act as trusted strategic advisor to senior decision-makers, helping them set priorities and make confident choices about customer data, journeys and marketing

• Shape a long-term vision for each client and own the 12-month strategic roadmap, translating business needs into prioritized use cases and roadmap reviews

• Bring clients a point of view on their industry, customers, competitors and opportunities ahead, before they ask for it

• Facilitate workshops and executive discussions that create alignment across stakeholders, functions and markets

• Turn complex challenges into clear narratives, business cases and decisions that move the organization forward

**Client leadership and commercial ownership

**

• Own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, with full accountability for revenue, margin and growth targets

• Spot where clients can create more value and shape it into proposals and business cases rooted in client outcomes

• Own the commercial health of your portfolio: budget, pricing, invoicing, margin, forecasting accuracy and risk, in close collaboration with your peers

**Partnership with Project Teams

**

• Working closely with Delivery Leads, you are responsible for keeping client goals, roadmap, scope and commercials aligned

• Make sure spend against budget is tracked, flag deviations early and own change order management

• Bring in the right Accrease experts across data, analytics, activation and technology for each client

• Be the strategic escalation point and stay close to client satisfaction

• Lead client kickoffs and closures, capture the value delivered and use it to shape the next step of the partnership

Today, these activities draw on resources from Production and Field Service. You will shape the workshop, build the team and competencies and establish the processes needed to handle spare part replacements, repairs and system updates efficiently across our radar portfolio. You will have the opportunity to build your own area of responsibility and set the direction for how the function develops as it grows.

A strong customer perspective will be central to the role. You will take responsibility for the complete repair journey, from the moment a need is reported until the radar or component is repaired, updated and ready to return to operation. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading and developing the team and setting clear direction and priorities as the function grows

• Building strong collaboration with Production, Field Service and relevant technical functions across Weibel

Your first three priorities

When you join, your first focus will be to turn the ambition into a functioning Repair & Service capability:

You are a hands-on technical leader who is motivated by building something new and making it work. You enjoy creating structure where the path is not yet fully defined and know how to turn technical expertise into a strong team and a well-functioning operation.

• A relevant technical background within electronics, electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent practical experience

• Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, repair and testing of advanced electronic, instrumentation or comparable technical systems

• Experience leading and developing technical specialists

• Experience establishing, developing or scaling a workshop, service or repair function

• A structured approach to processes, quality and continuous improvement

• Understanding of spare parts and material flows

• Strong communication skills in Danish and English

Contact and application

Develop physics-based wind and solar models and the Python software that brings them into daily use in energy trading.

The role

You will develop physics-based models of wind and solar production and build the Python software that puts them into reliable daily operation. Your work will support data validation, pricing, and hedging across our client business.

Over time, you will become the go-to person for asset modelling, taking ownership of model quality, and ensuring that consistent, traceable assumptions underpin our pricing and hedging decisions.

The team

The Pricing team develops and operates the models and analytical infrastructure used to evaluate deals and manage risk across our client business. We focus on making results reliable, traceable and useful for the decisions they support.

You will work alongside a software developer, quantitative developers and pricing analysts, while collaborating closely with colleagues in Forecasting, Portfolio Management and Client Success.

Your responsibilities

• Develop, validate and maintain physics-based wind and solar models, translating weather data and asset characteristics into expected production.

• Validate historical production data and distinguish underlying production potential from the effects of outages, curtailment and trading decisions.

• Build reusable Python components to calculate and store production estimates and expected volumes, ensuring traceability and reproducibility.

• Develop, test, deploy and operate Python models and supporting software, including monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance.

• Develop and maintain day-ahead and intraday renewable asset hindcasts used in pricing.

• Work with our Forecasting team to incorporate in-house weather data and forecasting methods into our asset models.

• Assess external production indices against our models and document the assumptions behind the analysis.

Our asset models are the foundation for how we price renewable energy contracts and estimate the volumes we hedge in the market. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their models, challenges the status quo and works closely with colleagues to turn theory into practice.

René Meklenborg Miltersen Slot

Manager, Pricing

You combine expertise in both wind and solar production modelling with strong Python skills and experience taking software into production. You take ownership of model quality and reliability, challenge assumptions and assess whether more complex models add practical value given the uncertainty involved.

We will help you develop your knowledge of pricing, hedging and energy markets. Previous experience in these areas is welcome but not required.

• A Master’s degree in engineering, physics, renewable energy or a related field.

• Several years of relevant experience in renewable asset modelling, energy yield assessment or a related technical role.

• Hands-on experience with reanalysis data, weather data and measured production time series.

• Experience using AI tools in daily coding, analysis or modelling, with a critical approach to reviewing and validating their outputs.

• The ability to communicate technical results clearly and collaborate across technical and commercial teams.

Advantageous experience

• Experience with historical weather forecasts, hindcasts or forecast verification.

• Experience combining physical models with statistical methods to improve production estimates.

• Familiarity with energy markets, PPA pricing or portfolio hedging.

What we offer

• Ownership of our renewable asset modelling capability, with a direct impact on commercial performance.

• The opportunity to combine renewable energy engineering, Python development and quantitative modelling in power markets.

• Hands-on modelling of real wind and solar assets using weather data and measured production.

• Close collaboration with developers, analysts, forecasters and portfolio managers.

• A strong technical environment, with room to shape our models and the analytical services around them.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**This role provides medical oversight of product safety, including adverse event review, ongoing safety surveillance, and management of emerging safety issues. Responsibilities include safety input to clinical and regulatory deliverables, aggregate reporting, safety committee oversight, cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring regulatory compliance and inspection readiness.

**Responsibilities

**

• Perform medical review of Adverse Events reports for Genmab products.

• Perform ongoing surveillance of safety data from Genmab clinical trials.

• Ensure handling of safety issues.

• Perform medical review and provide input to e.g., Trial Protocols and amendments, Trial Reports, Trial plans, eCRFs/CRFs, TMFs, Investigator’s Brochures, Subject Informed Consent, Development Safety Update Reports, Integrated Safety Summaries, scientific articles, and medical reviews.

• Prepare aggregated reports and safety summaries in accordance with regulatory requirements.

• Responsible for the establishment and management of external Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs)

• Chair and manage Genmab Safety Committees

• Conduct training of Genmab employees, CROs and Investigators

• Member of Clinical Management Teams (CMTs), Compound Development Teams (CDT) and Compound Strategy Teams (CST) and contribute to multidisciplinary project groups and provide input to clinical development programs.

• Interact with safety and clinical CROs and perform sponsor oversight activities.

• Collaborate with external experts and partners.

• Contribute to multidisciplinary project groups.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal procedures in order to be prepared for audits and inspections.

• Participate in audit and inspection activities as relevant

**Requirements

**

• Medical degree (MD or equivalent) with relevant clinical experience; oncology or hematology experience preferred.

• 5 - 8 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, or clinical development within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry.

• Demonstrated experience in adverse event medical review, safety surveillance, signal evaluation, benefit–risk assessment, and aggregate safety reporting.

• Experience providing medical safety input to clinical trials and regulatory deliverables, including protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, informed consent documents, DSURs, clinical study reports, and integrated safety summaries.

• Strong knowledge of global pharmacovigilance and clinical development requirements, with experience supporting Safety Committees/DMCs, regulatory submissions, audits, and inspections.

• Strong medical judgment, leadership, and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, CROs, external partners, and regulatory stakeholders.

• Experience executing processes/projects in own area (e.g. guidance documents as per intl. regulations & reporting requirements; preparation of post-marketing spontaneous and clinical trial safety assessments; regulatory submissions; safety case processing; PV data systems; safety data base systems and the report generation)

• Experience working with FDA/EMA/PMDA/ICH requirements, good clinical practices, and pharmaceutical clinical development

• Experience guiding team members around complex issues

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$200,000.00---$300,000.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

We don’t discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment, or if there’s anything else we can do to make the process more accessible, tell our Talent team. We’ll sort it.

**Your Safety Matters

**Be cautious of unexpected messages claiming to be from Board Intelligence. We will never ask you for fees as part of recruitment. If you’re unsure whether a communication is genuine, contact our Talent team through our official channels before sharing information or clicking links.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

CRH Denmark is on an ambitious journey to build a stronger, more connected and more resilient business. We are bringing our businesses closer together, sharpening our strategic focus and actively pursuing opportunities to strengthen our position across materials, infrastructure and the broader construction value chain.

As our new Senior Strategy & M&A Manager, you will be at the centre of that journey. Working closely with the CRH Denmark leadership team, our businesses and Strategy & Development colleagues across CRH International, you will help shape our long-term direction, drive key strategic analyses and M&A work, and identify the growth opportunities that can define what CRH Denmark becomes next.

The role

As Senior Strategy & M&A Manager, you will take on a broad role spanning long-term strategy, M&A and Business Development. You will lead complex strategic analyses and workstreams, develop recommendations for senior decision-makers and take responsibility for moving strategic opportunities from an initial question or idea to a well-founded decision.

The role combines independent ownership of complex work with close collaboration across CRH Denmark. It gives you the opportunity to work across businesses, markets and different parts of the value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Support our long-term strategy: Help drive the development of CRH Denmark’s long-term 3-to-5-year strategy. You will analyse markets, competitive dynamics, portfolio choices and growth opportunities and translate your insights into clear strategic choices, priorities and recommendations for the leadership team.

• Play a key role in our M&A activities, from opportunity screening and strategic assessment through business cases, valuation and due diligence to decision-making, transaction support and integration planning. You will lead relevant workstreams and coordinate contributions from internal teams and external advisers.

• Identify and assess opportunities beyond traditional M&A, including strategic investments, partnerships, joint ventures and new business models. You will combine strategic, commercial and financial perspectives to determine where new opportunities could create value for CRH Denmark.

• Work closely with the CRH Denmark leadership team and selected businesses as a trusted strategic sparring partner. You will build a deep understanding of their markets, value chains and competitive positions, challenge existing perspectives and proactively bring new strategic questions and opportunities to the table.

• Translate strategic choices and recommendations into clearly defined initiatives with a compelling business case, scope, ambition and high-level plan. You will help mobilise initiatives and remain involved as a strategic partner, while implementation is led by the relevant business or Transformation teams.

Who are you?
